faq.heading: Common questions
faq.subheading: Everything you might wonder before signing up
faq.a1: You get paid instantly. As soon as a customer completes a purchase, the money is transferred to your connected bank account — no waiting for monthly payouts.
faq.a2: No hidden fees whatsoever. We only charge 9% per successful sale — no monthly fees, no setup fees, no transaction minimums. What you see is what you get.
faq.a3: Saiflow is built for creators in Saudi Arabia first — with local payment methods, SAR pricing, and Arabic-first support tailored to your market.
faq.q4: What file types can I sell?
faq.a4: You can sell PDFs, ebooks, videos, audio files (MP3, WAV), ZIP archives, images, software, templates, and more. If it's digital, you can sell it on Saiflow.
faq.a5: Not at all. Saiflow is designed for creators, not developers. Upload your file, set a price, and share your link — that's it.
faq.a6: There's nothing to cancel. Since there are no monthly fees or subscriptions, you can stop using Saiflow whenever you want, with no penalties.
